description: Department of Elections - The Revision of registers of electors of Colombo District for the year 2015 that commenced from 15.05.2015
categorisation: This gazette content announces the commencement of the revision of electoral registers for 2015 under the Registration of Electors Act, specifies where electoral registers will be exhibited for public inspection, and outlines the process for enumeration of qualified electors. This directly relates to electoral processes and voter registration matters, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
